resources.name: GaAs material parameters (effective mass, dielectric constants, phonon frequencies)

access.notes: Effective masses from Cardona (1961) Phys. Rev. 121, 752. Phonon frequencies ωℓ, ωt and dielectric constants ε∞, ε0 from Mooradian & McWhorter (1967) Phys. Rev. Lett. 19, 849. The specific values needed are stated in the paper.

resources.name: Complex refractive index of GaAs (N, K) at 5145, 4880, 4765 Å

access.notes: Philipp & Ehrenreich (1963) Phys. Rev. 129, 1550. The resulting mean wavevectors <q> and spreads Δq are given in the paper's Table I.

resources.name: Raman tensor magnitudes a, b and interference factor D

access.notes: Mooradian & McWhorter (1967) Phys. Rev. Lett. 19, 849. Values: |a| = 6.4×10^7 cm^{-1}, |b| = 8.4×10^{-7} esu, D = -2.795.

resources.name: Experimental parameters (carrier densities, wavelengths, incident angle, reduction factors)

access.notes: Carrier densities: 8.4×10^17, 2×10^18, 4.5×10^18 cm^{-3}. Laser wavelengths: 5145, 4880, 4765 Å. Incident angle θ0=80°. Mean wavevectors <q> and spreads Δq from Table I, reduction factors I(θ0) from Table II of the paper. All explicit in the paper.
